description: Calculate a trip and save it under a name, traveller taken from the shared business profile; returns the TRIP-YYYY-NNNN id. An identical record is refused and named, spending no slot. Free: 5 trips a calendar month.

destination.description: Country or locality, e.g. "Germany", "Poland", "United Kingdom", "United States"

end.description: When it ended, same form as start. It must be after start as an instant

fiscal_year.description: US only, e.g. "FY2025". Defaults to the current bundled fiscal year

late_evening.description: UK only, per day: the journey was ongoing at 8pm and a meal was bought after it, which adds the 10.00 GBP supplement

lodging_nights.description: Nights of accommodation. What this pays depends on the scheme and the answer says so

meals_provided.description: Per day, in order: the free meals the traveller was given that day, e.g. [["breakfast"],["breakfast","lunch"]]. Each one reduces that day's allowance by the scheme's own percentage or amount

meals_provided_daily.description: The same free meals on every day. Ignored for any day that meals_provided already names

name.description: What to call it, e.g. "Berlin client workshop"

project.description: Project or client this belongs to; carried onto the expense payload

purpose.description: Why the trip happened; kept on the record and carried onto the expense payload

scheme.description: "pl" Polish delegation regulation, "uk" HMRC benchmark scale rates, "us" GSA CONUS standard

start.description: When the trip began, ISO 8601 WITH a zone: "2026-03-28T22:00:00+01:00", or "2026-03-28T22:00" together with timezone

timezone.description: IANA id such as "Europe/Warsaw". Required when start or end carries no offset; also the zone the US scheme counts calendar days in

traveller.description: Who travelled. Defaults to the shared business profile's name

name: trip_record
title: Save a calculated trip
